{{Quote|I speak on behalf of Professor Cornelius Wagglehorn of the University of Corellia. He seeks the assistance of an adventurer such as yourself to aid him. Would you be willing to lend such aid?|The Corellia University teaching assistant, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CS" />}}
A '''teaching assistant''' at the [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University]] worked for Professor [[Cornelius Wagglehorn]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] Wagglehorn lost contact with a [[Corellia University research outpost|mobile research outpost]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. As he didn't want to involve the authorities, he sought an independent being to investigate the situation at the camp. For this reason he sent his assistant to the hidden village of [[Aurilia]], where the assistant recruited an experienced adventurer to help Wagglehorn with his problem.

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellia University teaching assistant was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Corellia University teaching assistant was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>

The assistant could be found in the [[Adventurers' Guildhall]] in Aurilia on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], which was the hub and starting place for all Heroic Encounters. Talking to him started the prequest that gave the player access to the Exar Kun encounter.<ref name="SWG:CS" />
